LAREDO — A 21-year-old man was booked into the Webb County Jail early Sunday morning on an alleged felony drug charge, according to Webb County Sheriff's Office booking records.

Jones Garcia was arrested on October 25, 2026, at 4:04 a.m. The booking record lists possession of a controlled substance in Penalty Group 2 under one gram, a state jail felony, along with resisting arrest, search or transport, a Class A misdemeanor, and interference with public duties, a Class B misdemeanor. Bond had not been set on any of the charges.

A charge is an allegation, and every person is presumed innocent until proven guilty.

Sources: Webb County Sheriff's Office Booking Jail Search; Webb County public-access court records.

title: BREAKING: Jones Garcia arrested on felony drug charge
